routeDecision.selectedRouteReason: Microsoft Learn identifies General Posting Setup as the page that combines general business and product posting groups with G/L accounts. TARGET-032H shows a visible Neu action on Page 314, but prior cases did not isolate a standalone Neu route. A narrow Neu-only gate is the next non-repeating standard UI route before any values are typed.

rejectedOrDeferredRoutes.reason: TARGET-032D/TARGET-032E/TARGET-032H already show that List Edit, Ctrl+Insert, column/menu labels and broad form text are not trusted write routes.

Microsoft Learn describes copying accounts from existing General Posting Setup lines, and TARGET-032H tooltip says Kopieren requires a new target record first. It cannot create the first trusted INLAND/WAREN row by itself.

Microsoft Learn supports configuration packages for setup tables including General Posting Setup, but import/apply is a broad effective setup path. Prior VAT package work also left metadata/cleanup blockers. Use only after a separate package-design case, not as the next quick matrix route.

Microsoft Learn notes missing posting setups can lead Business Central to create placeholder posting groups or setups, but reaching that point would require documents/preview/posting-style flows that are explicitly locked before Foundation readiness.
